clinician.final_diagnosis: atypical chilblain-like lesions with prominent haemorrhagic bullae associated with COVID-19
clinician.trajectory_summary: A 27-year-old woman presented with bilateral oedematous, pruritic toes and multiple non-haemorrhagic bullae on the dorsum of her toes with erythema. She had a prior history 6 weeks earlier of ageusia and anosmia suggestive of COVID-19. Subsequent SARS-CoV-2 PCR testing was positive, confirming infection. A skin biopsy was ordered but no histopathology result was reported. At 3-month follow-up, the lesions resolved with residual scaling and violaceous hyperpigmentation and no recurrence or other symptoms were noted. The clinical presentation combined with confirmed COVID-19 infection supports diagnosis of atypical chilblain-like lesions with prominent bullae linked to COVID-19.
